messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — pages from incident-bot -> PagerDuty haven't gone out for ~15m. I just noticed from alerting dashboards. @mike can you take a look?

ops-bot: [integration-monitor] 15 failed webhook deliveries for /integrations/incident-bot (last status 422)

mike: Investigating. I see our adapter returned 422 even though PD returned 200. Pulling example payloads now.

sana: I didn't receive an on-call page. switching to manual paging for now.

taylor: I'm manually paging the P1 rotation. will post when folks ack.

mike: snippet from adapter log showing parse error:
```
ERROR: parse_exception at parse_payload: expected "incident.id", found null
incoming payload: {"id":"evt_123","incident":{"identifier":"inc-987","summary":"..."}}
```

alyssa: That looks like a recent change — upstream moved id from incident.id -> id, but our parser expects incident.id.

mike: Confirmed. Looks like our contract test passed locally but the production webhook had slightly different shape.

linh: Quick mitigation: I've pushed a small tolerant-parser hotfix to the adapter that checks both paths. Deploying now.

ops-bot: deploybot: new release incident-adapter v2.14.3 deployed to prod (id: deploy_3322114450)

mike: After hotfix, PagerDuty delivery successful. 6 pages sent, 4 on-call acks.

sana: Received manual page and the resumed pages. No customers reported missed incident pages yet; support ticket #4567 opened to follow up.

taylor: Root cause: schema drift from upstream webhook + no schema validation in adapter. Action items: 1) add JSON schema validation + CI test, 2) add alert to detect sustained 4xx adapter responses, 3) update runbook for manual fallback paging.

alyssa: Filing a short incident writeup and runbook updates. Assigning follow-ups to @mike @linh @taylor. I'll schedule a 1hr retro.

ops-bot: [incident-monitor] incident status -> mitigated
